# SORTS: The Word Library

> SORTS is a premium, ad-free word puzzle game for iPhone and iPad by White Wiki
> (whitewiki.org). Players trace words across a board of chunky letter blocks in any
> direction; any real word of three letters or more scores on lift-off, scored blocks
> burst, and matching colours chain into cascades. Free to play; no ads; no pay-to-win.

## Key facts
- Full name: SORTS: The Word Library. Platform: iOS and iPadOS. Status: coming soon.
- Campaign: 300 hand-tuned levels across three illustrated books (a hundred to a
  book), with page-gated chapters. Pages are earned through play and cannot be bought.
- Modes: Daily Edition in The Parlour (streak rewards), the Compositor's Cabinet
  (a letterpress match-3: match inks, set the stick, print the word), Endless Mode
  (free players get 3 runs a day), same-room 60-second duels (free, no accounts needed).
- Social: Guilds of up to 5 players, weekly pooled scores, a shared Guild Library
  (Commonplace Book), the Guild League, and a weekly Forbidden Section volume that a
  guild unlocks together.
- Monetisation: free to play with an optional Pressroom Pass subscription (monthly or
  annual: double coins, unlimited Endless Mode, all Print Shop tile skins and inks,
  members-only Titles, starter boosters). Optional coin packs. No ads either way.
- Privacy: no ads, no third-party advertising or analytics SDKs, no data sold. Player
  data lives in Apple iCloud (CloudKit) and Game Center; purchases are handled by Apple.
